verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has a dedicated versioning page stating that a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. Versioned endpoints (v2 case audit trail, v3 transaction process) and a 308 Permanent Redirect on the external-identifier lookup show this applied in practice. The evidence does not show a documented deprecation policy, such as notice periods, sunset timelines or support windows for old versions. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, changelog or deprecation notices, independent corroboration of version stability.
